head_commit.message:
Prepare isolated finite validation for SQLite and queue observation

Validate exact source 4ca5b2f0 with its two-literal capability count correction and strict inverse to formatted 3a54. The source-only formatter evidence and 58-case queue closure remain separately pinned. This harness adds scoped lint, format and types, three original source gates, and 169 fresh source-selected cases including ten compiled C callbacks and actual Python SQLite controls.

Retain source and owned environment identities, original commands and process-group cleanup, per-case collection/phases/JUnit, compiler receipts and bounded complete log frames before the final upload gate. No parser/compiler/test execution has yet occurred for this harness. No installed, native campaign, kernel/physical I/O, performance or original PRD completion credit.
